sections.title: Look beyond an appointment-scheduling label
paragraphs:

sections.title: Use a garage door buying worksheet
paragraphs:

| --- | --- | --- |

Do not copy a fee from a provider's example into your own instructions. Your business must supply its current authorized charge and decide what the visit includes.

sections.title: Request one demonstration with two outcomes
paragraphs:
Use fictional details for a repair inquiry and an installation-estimate request. Have the supplier show what the caller hears and where each resulting task appears. Then ask what happens if no approved slot is available. A useful answer identifies the fallback owner without inventing a confirmed visit.

Keep mechanical diagnosis and safety instructions outside this comparison. An answering plan does not establish that a handler can assess a damaged door or authorize a repair.

Only after it satisfies the required request types. Compare the complete billing period and any separate charges for the booking or escalation functions you need.

record.description: Understand Jill's Office account fees, weekly minute brackets, annual commitments and optional AI overflow before comparing reception plans.
record.lead: Jill's Office is a live answering option for service businesses. Its pricing deserves a weekly calculation: the account fee, usage brackets and annual commitment are separate parts of the purchase.
record.intro: Jill's Office is a live answering option for service businesses. Its pricing deserves a weekly calculation: the account fee, usage brackets and annual commitment are separate parts of the purchase.

sections.title: Start with the current billing structure
paragraphs:
[Jill's Office pricing](https://jillsoffice.com/pricing/) lists weekly account fees of $39 for Receptionist, $59 for Complete and $89 for Advance. Usage is additional. The page distinguishes a weekly offer with a setup charge from an annual account fee paid upfront, with different minute rates and no setup fee under that annual offer.

Do not read the account fee as the complete answering bill. The supplier describes tiered weekly usage: different portions of the same week's minutes can carry different rates. It also states that the usage ranges reset weekly.

sections.title: Work through a matching example
paragraphs:
The pricing page's Receptionist and Complete weekly table charges the first 49 minutes at $2.00 and the following range at $1.80. For a fictional 100-minute week, the published calculation is:

49 × $2.00 + 51 × $1.80 = $189.80 in usage.

For Receptionist, adding the published $39 weekly account fee gives $228.80 before any applicable setup charge, tax or other item. This is a planning example, not a quote or customer result. Do not apply these particular brackets to Advance or the annual offer.

Use the same weekly workload when comparing alternatives. Four weeks is not a calendar month, and a monthly provider's included allowance may reset differently.

sections.title: Separate commitment from coverage
paragraphs:
The pricing page says annual account fees are non-refundable even though cancellation is available. Confirm what cancellation stops, what remains paid and when the account fee begins. [Jill's Office terms](https://jillsoffice.com/terms-of-service/) also matter for the first billing period; do not assume usage starts only after every onboarding task is complete.

| Purchase question | Evidence to retain |
| --- | --- |
| Which plan includes the required booking or escalation work? | Selected feature scope and system requirements |
| How are minutes divided across weekly brackets? | Rate table and a calculation for your own workload |
| Is AI Assist part of the purchase? | Its optional overflow rate and the charge when a person takes over |
| What does an annual payment commit? | Upfront account fee, non-refundability and cancellation terms |

sections.title: Where Revo belongs in the comparison
paragraphs:
Revo offers AI reception, rather than Jill's live-receptionist staffing model. Compare [current Revo plans](/pricing) against the actual calls, allowed actions and billing unit you need. Do not assume either provider duplicates every function of the other.

### Is $39 per week the complete Jill's Office price?
No. The published structure adds usage and may add setup or other applicable charges.

### Does optional AI overflow make every call an AI call?
No. Ask when the optional service answers and how usage changes when the caller reaches a person.

record.lead: The best AI voice for handling virtual reception tasks must be understandable in the calls your business actually receives. A polished greeting is only the beginning. sections.title: Separate a voice option from a completed reception task
paragraphs:
[RingCentral AI Receptionist](https://www.ringcentral.com/ai-receptionist.html) documents multiple professional voice options and provides demonstrations. [Allo's AI receptionist page](https://www.withallo.com/product/ai-receptionist) identifies ElevenLabs voices and includes demonstration clips. These establish published options and examples, not that one voice will outperform another for your callers.

A voice engine alone is not a complete answering service. Check the actual reception product, its supported business instructions and the resulting message or appointment. Do not buy a developer tool expecting a configured front desk unless that service is explicitly included.

sections.title: Bring this audition sheet
paragraphs:
Use fictional details and the same request for every supplier. Ask permission to use the supplier's demonstration environment; do not place fabricated jobs into a real business account.

| Test | What to listen for | What to inspect afterward |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A corrected callback number | The correction is acknowledged without leaving the caller unsure which number was retained | The final summary contains the corrected fictional number |
| An unfamiliar street name | The handler asks for clarification instead of confidently substituting another address | The uncertainty is resolved or clearly recorded |
| A change from repair to estimate request | The response follows the corrected purpose | The final task reflects the request the caller actually made |
| A question outside the approved information | The response explains the next step without inventing an answer | The unresolved question reaches its owner |

Mark each result as observed, unclear or not supported. Keep your notes about intelligibility separate from whether the correct task reached the office. Do not report a latency score or accuracy percentage unless you actually measured it using a defined method.

sections.title: Ask what you are allowed to change
paragraphs:
Confirm which voices the selected account includes, which languages are supported and who can change the selection. Do not infer voice cloning, a custom accent or an unrestricted voice editor from a personalized greeting. If a specific voice or language is mandatory, obtain evidence before buying.

Revo's published business instructions do not establish custom voice selection. [Hear the available Revo sample](/hear-a-sample-call) and [review current plans](/pricing), then confirm the supported configuration rather than assuming a feature from another provider's documentation.

### Does a natural voice prove correct booking?
No. Inspect the resulting booking or request separately.

### Can a recorded demo establish performance for my office?
It can illustrate a flow. It does not establish how your configured account will handle every caller or condition.

record.title: Answering Service Money-Back Guarantees: What Is at Risk?
record.description: Compare an answering service money-back guarantee by eligibility, refund cap, excluded charges, deadline and request process before paying.
record.lead: A money-back guarantee can reduce a purchase risk, but its headline does not tell you which charges are refundable. Before paying an answering provider, identify the exact offer, the covered amount and the process for requesting a refund.
record.intro: A money-back guarantee can reduce a purchase risk, but its headline does not tell you which charges are refundable. Before paying an answering provider, identify the exact offer, the covered amount and the process for requesting a refund.

sections.title: Separate four different promises
paragraphs:
A free trial concerns access before or during a defined evaluation. Cancellation concerns ending future service. A service credit reduces a later charge under stated conditions. A refund returns an eligible payment. None automatically establishes the others.

[Phone.com's AI receptionist page](https://www.phone.com/ai-receptionist/) advertises a 30-day money-back guarantee while describing its AI product as an add-on to a phone plan. Ask which purchase and charges the applicable policy covers rather than assuming the add-on and the whole account have identical treatment.

[Smith.ai's published guarantee FAQ](https://smithaivoiceassistant.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/151000200042-smith-ai-money-back-guarantee-faq) discusses eligibility, a refund cap and excluded overage charges. Its named plans and timing language need reconciliation with the offer you are buying. Do not apply an older help article to a different current plan without written confirmation.

sections.title: Complete a refundable-budget worksheet
paragraphs:
| Question | Record from the applicable offer |
| --- | --- |
| Who qualifies? | New-account requirement, selected product and any excluded plan |
| When does the clock start? | Purchase, activation or another event explicitly stated in the policy |
| What payment is covered? | Subscription, setup, add-ons and usage listed separately |
| Is there a cap? | The maximum refundable amount and how it applies |
| What remains excluded? | Overage, taxes or other charges only where the policy actually says so |
| How is the request made? | Required destination, deadline, information and confirmation |

For a fictional purchase, suppose $150 is paid and the confirmed policy covers $100 while excluding $50 of usage. The maximum refund in that example is $100, not $150. This illustrates the worksheet; it is not a supplier's policy or a customer outcome.

sections.title: Keep the purchase decision separate from the refund request
paragraphs:
Use the written scope to decide whether the exposure is acceptable before connecting business calls. Retain the selected offer and a dated record of any clarification. If the pricing page and policy conflict, ask the supplier to resolve the conflict rather than combining favorable sentences from each.

Our [free-trial acceptance guide](/ai-answering-service/answering-service-free-trial) covers evaluating call handling. This worksheet covers money already paid and the portion the applicable policy may return.

### Does cancellation guarantee a refund?
No. Check the actual refund conditions separately.

### Does this establish a Revo money-back guarantee?
No. [Review Revo's current plans](/pricing) and applicable terms. Do not buy on the assumption that a competitor's guarantee also applies to Revo.
